scientific_integrity: Fourier eigenvalue identities, root interval and strict positivity estimates are proven; numerical experiments confirm finite cases only. Independent validation was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite Hamming Cartesian products only; unnormalized Hamming distance squared; no claim for arbitrary metric subsets or other powers. Existing restricted binary-alphabet result is acknowledged. Priority beyond checked literature is not certified.
title: Alphabet-universal positivity cutoff for squared-Hamming Gaussian kernels
